title: BAFTA 2027 entries: 126 films and 728 performances
body_md:
The preliminary entered films list for the 2027 BAFTA Film Awards has revealed a considerably larger field of contenders in several categories. The best film race currently includes 126 entries, compared with 109 eligible titles last year. Across the four acting categories, 728 performances have been entered for consideration.

**These are preliminary submissions, not the BAFTA longlists or final nominations. The list remains subject to amendments.**

## Major films pursue multiple categories

According to the published analysis, 44 films have entered all twelve categories available to them, covering best film, directing, screenplay and nine craft races. They include Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three, Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey, Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day and Robert Eggers' Werwulf.

Project Hail Mary, Wuthering Heights and Spider-Man: Brand New Day also appear among the films pursuing the full range of those categories. Across the broader field, 213 features are competing in best film, directing, writing or craft categories. Including titles submitted only in specialist races brings the overall total to 235.

The breadth of submissions demonstrates the ambitions of distributors rather than the preferences of BAFTA voters. A film's presence in twelve categories does not mean it will advance in all twelve.

## Why Amanda Seyfried is ineligible

One notable absence concerns Amanda Seyfried's performance in You Can See Everything, Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's documentary about Elizabeth Holmes. Seyfried returns to the role of Holmes in dramatized sequences, following her Emmy-winning portrayal in The Dropout.

BAFTA's eligibility rules exclude that performance from its acting categories. The documentary itself remains entered for best film, directing, documentary and seven craft awards. Seyfried's absence is therefore a matter of eligibility, not an indication that voters rejected her performance.

Six performers have four entries each, including Zendaya, Robert Pattinson, Anne Hathaway and Sandra Huller. Their appearances across multiple films offer several possible routes into the acting races, although none is guaranteed a nomination.

## When the field will narrow

Distributors and producers have until November 30, 2026, to request amendments. The official entered films list is scheduled for December 4, when the first round of voting opens. BAFTA is due to publish its longlists on January 7, 2027, followed by nominations on January 19.

The eightieth BAFTA Film Awards ceremony is scheduled for February 21, 2027, in London. Until voting produces those narrower lists, the preliminary figures should be treated as an overview of the eligible field rather than evidence of awards momentum or a prediction of winners.

[Source report](https://variety.com/2026/film/awards/bafta-2027-entries-full-list-amanda-seyfried-1236959765)
